description: A SolveSpace file 'line_to_constrain.slvs' is already open in the application. It contains a 2D sketch with a line segment that is not yet constrained to be horizontal. Your task is to add a horizontal constraint to this line. First, click on the line segment in the canvas to select it. Then apply a 'Horizontal' constraint using the Constrain menu (Constrain > Horizontal, shortcut H). The line will snap to horizontal and the constraint will appear in the Property Browser. After adding the constraint, save the modified file as '/home/ga/Documents/SolveSpace/side_constrained.slvs' using File > Save As.
